task_summary: Refresh an authorized local text collection and update interpretation using new evidence. Private source content, identities and individual assessments are excluded from this archive.
workflow_version: WORKFLOW_REVIEW.md + WORKFLOW_DATABASE.md read in current chat

acceptance: Preserve the baseline and retrieve new records without exposing credentials.
Read the complete text increment, including quoted context, and distinguish observed behavior from interpretation.
Keep source content local and independently check conclusions.
completed: Saved a fresh full snapshot and separate structured and readable increments.
Verified all prior records remain and selected textual fields are unchanged.
Verified one rendered header per new record and all quoted-context fields are present.
Coordinator and one read-only reviewer read the complete increment.
Retained prior user corrections and separated actual actions from future intentions.

metrics.name: New records read
metrics.basis: Identifier difference; both readers completed the full increment.

metrics.name: Preserved baseline records
metrics.basis: No missing prior identifiers or changed selected textual fields.

metrics.name: Quoted records rendered
metrics.basis: Structured source count and text quote-prefix count match.

metrics.name: Native reviewers
metrics.basis: One existing reviewer received a new read-only task and returned a complete review.

metrics.name: Observed processing interval
metrics.basis: First captured local clock to report preparation; excludes initial setup and later archive.

metrics.name: Coordination wait
metrics.basis: Independent reading overlapped; no isolated wait measurement.

metrics.name: Failed workflow command invocations
metrics.basis: Two read-only invocations used incorrect option names, corrected using CLI help.

metrics.name: Review and archive overhead
metrics.basis: Review interleaved with analysis and archival continues after cutoff.

observations: Identifier-based increments preserve the prior evidence boundary and avoid treating previously reviewed material as new.
Direct requests and performed actions support narrower conclusions than speculative motive inference.
Agreement between readers is a quality check, not independent verification of historical claims.
Two workflow CLI flag errors created avoidable coordination rework.
No matched quality baseline exists for a speedup claim.

recommendations.action: Preserve source identifiers and quoted context in incremental exports; verify baseline retention and rendered counts before interpretation.
recommendations.next_check: The next incremental refresh should repeat bounded integrity checks and distinguish new evidence from prior assumptions.

recommendations.action: Use verified CLI argument names for each subcommand; when summaries omit syntax, inspect help before invocation.
recommendations.next_check: Future workflow archives should avoid repeated unsupported-flag invocations.

evidence: Local snapshot comparison: baseline retained, no selected-text changes, increment fully rendered.
Independent read-only review returned and reconciled with coordinator findings.
Repository visibility confirmed private before archive; post-upload readback pending at this cutoff.
limits: Media content was not independently interpreted.
Text analysis cannot certify private historical accounts, hidden motives, or future conduct.
Exact start time, token use, cost and isolated overhead are unavailable.
Remote archive verification is recorded separately after upload.
